title: Welcome to the Hierarchy Academy
summary: A quick tour of how the academy, check-ins and community work, so you know where everything is.
checklist: Post your goal for this week in #weekly-goals
Find your private check-in channel (it starts with checkin-)
assignment: Post your goal for this week in #weekly-goals, then reply in this thread with one thing you want to learn in the academy.

questions.q: Where do you find each academy lesson?
options: In the #lessons forum, one post per lesson
questions.explanation: Every lesson is its own post in the #lessons forum. Discussion and assignments happen in that lesson's thread.

questions.q: What do you need to score to pass a quiz?
questions.explanation: The pass mark is 70%. If you miss it, you can retake the quiz after an hour.

questions.q: What happens when you pass a module's quizzes?
options: You get a Module Complete role and the next module unlocks
You are removed from the server
questions.explanation: You earn the Module Complete role, the next module unlocks, and your win is celebrated in #wins.
